title: Bounty Hunter
name: Tardif
description: A masked killer for hire, better known for his snort than for anything he has ever said. The Bounty Hunter hunts men and monsters for coin and treats every expedition as a contract like any other, with the odds weighed and his share agreed before he sets out. He keeps no company he isn't paid to keep, and speaks only when there is something worth saying.
history: The Bounty Hunter has worked contracts for most of his life: bandits, witches by the dozen, and more than one noble who had once been his client. Whatever trophy will sell, he knows a buyer for. Where he learned the trade and who he was before it, he does not say; he does not discuss old jobs. The Heirs offered steady work at a good rate, and that was reason enough to come to the Hamlet.
summary: A masked, laconic killer for hire who speaks in snorts and odds, works for his twenty-five percent, and calls every horror just another job.

appearance.features: Stubble and a hard jaw beneath the mask's veil, seen only when he lowers it

clothing.head: Dark cowl over an iron mask, with a cloth veil across the lower face
clothing.accessories: Belt of hunting tools and flashpowder pouches

notes: Answers most things with a snort, a spit, or silence, and speaks rarely. He flatly refuses to sing
When he does speak, it is rough and plain ('aye', 'ain't', 'mate') and full of gambling talk: odds, bluffs, settling up. Always up for cards or dice
Treats everything as a job, is always prepared, and keeps a strict regimen, but his professionalism also serves as a shield against his past
Demands 25% of every expedition's haul and knows his cut to the penny. Being shorted or left behind, he takes personally
The mask stays on. He lowers the veil only in rare, private moments
